name: _body.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_body.scss — scrollable body — pref sections/titles/descs, option grids, lang-glass follower, lang dialog variant, theme slider track + WebGL canvas, labels, option/stat buttons.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Scrollable content area of the dialog.
.pref-body {
  flex: 1; // Fill remaining space in the flex-column dialog
  min-height: 0; // Allow shrinking so overflow-y:auto actually scrolls
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-3xl);
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;

  // Scrollbar — themed to match modal dialog background
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-color) transparent;
  scrollbar-width: thin;

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  }
}

// A settings group (theme, switches, dev tools).
.pref-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
}

// Group heading.
.pref-section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: to-rem(18);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(0.8);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// Group helper text.
.pref-section-desc {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: to-rem(15);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

// Grid of selectable options.
.pref-options {
  display: grid;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  position: relative;

  &--4 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    @media (max-width: $bk-540) {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
  }

  &--3 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }

  &--2 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

// Moving glass highlight that follows selection in the language grid.
.lang-glass-follower {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-featured);
  transition:
    transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    width 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    height 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    opacity 0.2s ease;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
}

// Language dialog variant (shared shell with pref).
.lang-dialog {
  // 480px cap on wide screens; on narrow screens the backdrop padding
  // already constrains width, so max-width: 100% lets it fill the grid.
  max-width: min(to-rem(480), 100%);
}

// Theme slider block (canvas + labels + fallback buttons).
.pref-theme-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  width: 100%;
}

// Slider row: WebGL canvas with the light/system/dark stops.
.pref-theme-slider {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: none;
}

// The WebGL theme slider canvas.
.pref-theme-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: to-rem(64);
  border-radius: to-rem(32);
  display: block;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    transform: scale(1.01);
  }

  &:active {
    transform: scale(0.99);
  }
}

// light / system / dark labels under the slider.
.pref-theme-labels {
  display: none;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);
  width: 100%;
}

.pref-theme-wrapper.has-fallback .pref-theme-labels,
.pref-theme-slider:not(:has(.pref-theme-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])))
  + .pref-theme-labels {
  display: grid;
}

// Fallback theme buttons when the canvas can't render.
.pref-theme-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--text-muted);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
  }

  &--active {
    border-color: var(--text-primary);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm) rgba($color-black, 0.08);
  }
}

// One selectable preference option (language/grid/etc).
.pref-option-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  overflow: visible;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-sm);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem(2) solid transparent;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    filter 0.2s ease;

  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--btn-accent-fill);
    border-radius: inherit;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--text-muted);
    transform: translateY(to-rem(-$space-3xs)) scale(1.03);

    &::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    > * {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }
  }

  &.active {
    border-color: var(--text-primary);
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}

// Small stat card inside the dev-tools analytics block.
.pref-stat-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-sm);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: center;
}
